prior.system: You generate one Koko query for an embedded property-graph database. Koko uses a Cypher-compatible query language. Use only the supplied schema and parameters. Never invent labels, relationship types, properties, functions, or parameter names. Reads must not mutate data. Writes must affect only the records named by the task. Return exactly one JSON object matching the supplied response schema and no prose or markdown.

guided.system: You generate one Koko query for an embedded property-graph database. Use only the supplied schema and parameters; never invent names. Return exactly one JSON object matching the response schema and no prose. Koko's current dialect differs from Neo4j in these ways: list element positions are 1-based; a whole-node SET such as SET n = $patch patches only supplied properties and preserves the rest; SET += is unsupported; bounded recursive relationships put the mode and bounds after *, for example [:DEPENDS_ON*TRAIL 1..5] or [:DEPENDS_ON*SHORTEST 1..5], and shortestPath(...) is unsupported. Use explicit relationship direction, explicit result aliases, explicit YIELD lists, ORDER BY before a result-sensitive LIMIT, and a finite upper bound on every recursive path. Reads must not mutate data. Writes must narrowly match only the requested records.

people.prompt:

Node Team(id STRING PRIMARY KEY, name STRING)
Relationship MEMBER_OF: (Person)-[since INT64, role STRING]->(Team)

tasks.prompt:
Node Task(id STRING PRIMARY KEY, title STRING, status STRING, priority INT64, owner STRING, estimate INT64, tags STRING[])
Node Artifact(name STRING PRIMARY KEY, kind STRING, risk INT64)
Relationship DEPENDS_ON: (Task)-[]->(Task); direction is task to its prerequisite
Relationship TOUCHES: (Task)-[change STRING]->(Artifact)
Built-ins: CALL topological_levels(['Task'], ['DEPENDS_ON']) YIELD node, level; CALL weakly_connected_components(['Task'], ['DEPENDS_ON']) YIELD node, component_id; CALL page_rank(['Task'], ['DEPENDS_ON']) YIELD node, score
setup: CREATE NODE TABLE Task(id STRING, title STRING, status STRING, priority INT64, owner STRING, estimate INT64, tags STRING[], PRIMARY KEY(id))
CREATE NODE TABLE Artifact(name STRING, kind STRING, risk INT64, PRIMARY KEY(name))
CREATE REL TABLE DEPENDS_ON(FROM Task TO Task)
CREATE REL TABLE TOUCHES(FROM Task TO Artifact, change STRING)

cases.task: Return active people's names as name, ordered alphabetically.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.active = true RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name

cases.task: Return id and name for people whose age is at least $min_age, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age >= $min_age RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return each person in $city as id and name, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city = $city RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return every person's id and first tag as first_tag, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id, p.tags[1] AS first_tag ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return ids of people whose tags contain 'rust', ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 'rust' IN p.tags RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return names beginning with $prefix, ordered by name.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name STARTS WITH $prefix RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name

cases.task: Return each city and its number of people as people, ordered by city.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.city AS city, count(*) AS people ORDER BY city

cases.task: Return each city and average age as average_age, ordered by city.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.city AS city, avg(p.age) AS average_age ORDER BY city

cases.task: Return the oldest person's id, name, and age. Break ties by lower id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.age AS age ORDER BY age DESC, id LIMIT 1

cases.task: For team $team_id, return member id, member name, and relationship role, ordered by member id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person)-[m:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) WHERE t.id = $team_id RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, m.role AS role ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return every team id and its member count as members, including empty teams, ordered by team id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t) RETURN t.id AS team_id, count(p) AS members ORDER BY team_id

cases.task: Return ids of teams with no members, ordered by team_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t) WITH t, count(p) AS members WHERE members = 0 RETURN t.id AS team_id ORDER BY team_id

cases.task: Return each nonempty team's id and maximum member age as oldest_age, ordered by team id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) RETURN t.id AS team_id, max(p.age) AS oldest_age ORDER BY team_id

cases.task: Return ids and names of people directly followed by person $id, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(q:Person) WHERE p.id = $id RETURN q.id AS id, q.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return ids and names of people who directly follow person $id, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(q:Person) WHERE q.id = $id RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return every person's id and number of outgoing FOLLOWS relationships as follows, including zero, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:FOLLOWS]->(:Person) RETURN p.id AS id, count(r) AS follows ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return ids of people with no outgoing FOLLOWS relationship, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:FOLLOWS]->(:Person) } RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return the sum of outgoing follow strength for person $id as total_strength.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:FOLLOWS]->(:Person) WHERE p.id = $id RETURN sum(r.strength) AS total_strength

cases.task: For every id in $ids that exists, return id and name ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: UNWIND $ids AS selected_id MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.id = selected_id RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: For person $id, return tags beginning with 'p' as tag, ordered by tag.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.id = $id UNWIND p.tags AS tag WITH tag WHERE tag STARTS WITH 'p' RETURN tag AS tag ORDER BY tag

cases.task: Return id and an age_bucket equal to 'senior' for age at least 60, 'mid' for age at least 40, otherwise 'young'; order by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id, CASE WHEN p.age >= 60 THEN 'senior' WHEN p.age >= 40 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'young' END AS age_bucket ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return each id and nickname when present, otherwise name, as display_name; order by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id, coalesce(p.nickname, p.name) AS display_name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Patch person $id with properties from $patch while preserving every unspecified property.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.id = $id SET p = $patch
verify: MATCH (p:Person {id: 1}) RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.age AS age, p.city AS city, p.nickname AS nickname, p.active AS active

cases.task: Set person $id's age to $age without changing other properties.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.id = $id SET p.age = $age
verify: MATCH (p:Person {id: 3}) RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.age AS age, p.city AS city

cases.task: Create person $id with name $name, age $age, city $city, tags $tags, and active $active.
cases.reference_query: CREATE (:Person {id: $id, name: $name, age: $age, city: $city, tags: $tags, active: $active})
verify: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.id = 6 RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.age AS age, p.city AS city, p.tags AS tags, p.active AS active

cases.task: Create one FOLLOWS relationship from person $from_id to person $to_id with since $since and strength $strength.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person) WHERE a.id = $from_id AND b.id = $to_id CREATE (a)-[:FOLLOWS {since: $since, strength: $strength}]->(b)
verify: MATCH (a:Person)-[r:FOLLOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE a.id = 5 AND b.id = 1 RETURN a.id AS from_id, b.id AS to_id, r.since AS since, r.strength AS strength ORDER BY since

cases.task: Delete only the FOLLOWS relationship from person $from_id to person $to_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (a:Person)-[r:FOLLOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE a.id = $from_id AND b.id = $to_id DELETE r
verify: MATCH (a:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.id AS from_id, b.id AS to_id ORDER BY from_id, to_id

cases.task: Delete person $id and all relationships attached to that person, without deleting any other person.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.id = $id DETACH DELETE p
verify: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (:Person)-[r:FOLLOWS]->(:Person) RETURN count(r) AS follows

cases.task: Match or merge person $id; because it exists, set its city to $city.
cases.reference_query: MERGE (p:Person {id: $id}) ON MATCH SET p.city = $city
verify: MATCH (p:Person {id: 5}) RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.city AS city

cases.task: Set strength to $strength only on the FOLLOWS relationship from $from_id to $to_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (a:Person)-[r:FOLLOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE a.id = $from_id AND b.id = $to_id SET r.strength = $strength
verify: MATCH (a:Person)-[r:FOLLOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE a.id = 1 AND b.id = 3 RETURN a.id AS from_id, b.id AS to_id, r.strength AS strength

cases.task: Return every file path and language, ordered by path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) RETURN f.path AS path, f.language AS language ORDER BY path

cases.task: Return paths of files whose language is $language, ordered by path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.language = $language RETURN f.path AS path ORDER BY path

cases.task: Return path and lines for files with at least $min_lines lines, ordered by lines descending then path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.lines >= $min_lines RETURN f.path AS path, f.lines AS lines ORDER BY lines DESC, path

cases.task: Return test file paths ordered by path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.is_test = true RETURN f.path AS path ORDER BY path

cases.task: Return each language and number of files as files, ordered by language.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) RETURN f.language AS language, count(*) AS files ORDER BY language

cases.task: Return the total lines across Rust files as total_lines.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.language = 'rust' RETURN sum(f.lines) AS total_lines

cases.task: For file $path, return declared symbol id, name, and kind ordered by symbol id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File)-[:DECLARES]->(s:Symbol) WHERE f.path = $path RETURN s.id AS id, s.name AS name, s.kind AS kind ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return file path and symbol name for declarations whose DECLARES.exported is true, ordered by path then name.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File)-[d:DECLARES]->(s:Symbol) WHERE d.exported = true RETURN f.path AS path, s.name AS name ORDER BY path, name

cases.task: Return ids and names of public function symbols, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (s:Symbol) WHERE s.kind = 'function' AND s.visibility = 'public' RETURN s.id AS id, s.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return every file path and its declared symbol count as symbols, including zero, ordered by path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[d:DECLARES]->(:Symbol) RETURN f.path AS path, count(d) AS symbols ORDER BY path

cases.task: Return paths of files declaring no symbols, ordered by path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[d:DECLARES]->(:Symbol) WITH f, count(d) AS declarations WHERE declarations = 0 RETURN f.path AS path ORDER BY path

cases.task: For file $path, return directly imported paths and import kind, ordered by imported_path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File)-[i:IMPORTS]->(dependency:File) WHERE f.path = $path RETURN dependency.path AS imported_path, i.kind AS kind ORDER BY imported_path

cases.task: For file $path, return paths of files that directly import it, ordered by path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (dependent:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(f:File) WHERE f.path = $path RETURN dependent.path AS path ORDER BY path

cases.task: Return distinct files reachable from $path through one to three outgoing IMPORTS hops as dependency, ordered by dependency.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File)-[:IMPORTS*TRAIL 1..3]->(dependency:File) WHERE f.path = $path RETURN DISTINCT dependency.path AS dependency ORDER BY dependency

cases.task: Return one shortest path from file $from_path to file $to_path using between one and four IMPORTS hops as path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH path = (source:File)-[:IMPORTS*SHORTEST 1..4]->(target:File) WHERE source.path = $from_path AND target.path = $to_path RETURN path AS path LIMIT 1

cases.task: For symbol $symbol_id, return ids and names of symbols that directly call it, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (caller:Symbol)-[:CALLS]->(target:Symbol) WHERE target.id = $symbol_id RETURN caller.id AS id, caller.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: For symbol $symbol_id, return ids and names of symbols it directly calls, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (source:Symbol)-[:CALLS]->(callee:Symbol) WHERE source.id = $symbol_id RETURN callee.id AS id, callee.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return the sum of CALLS.count over all call relationships as calls.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (:Symbol)-[c:CALLS]->(:Symbol) RETURN sum(c.count) AS calls

cases.task: Return distinct symbol ids that can reach $symbol_id through one to three CALLS hops as caller_id, ordered by caller_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (caller:Symbol)-[:CALLS*TRAIL 1..3]->(target:Symbol) WHERE target.id = $symbol_id RETURN DISTINCT caller.id AS caller_id ORDER BY caller_id

cases.task: Return names and versions of direct packages, ordered by name.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Package) WHERE p.direct = true RETURN p.name AS name, p.version AS version ORDER BY name

cases.task: For package $name, return direct dependency name and dependency scope, ordered by dependency.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Package)-[d:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Package) WHERE p.name = $name RETURN dependency.name AS dependency, d.scope AS scope ORDER BY dependency

cases.task: Return distinct dependencies reachable from package $name in one to three DEPENDS_ON hops, ordered by dependency.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (p:Package)-[:DEPENDS_ON*TRAIL 1..3]->(dependency:Package) WHERE p.name = $name RETURN DISTINCT dependency.name AS dependency ORDER BY dependency

cases.task: Return package names that directly depend on $name, ordered by dependent.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (dependent:Package)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(p:Package) WHERE p.name = $name RETURN dependent.name AS dependent ORDER BY dependent

cases.task: Return failed test names and durations, ordered by name.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Test) WHERE t.status = 'fail' RETURN t.name AS name, t.duration AS duration ORDER BY name

cases.task: For test $test_name, return covered symbol id and hits, ordered by symbol id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Test)-[c:COVERS]->(s:Symbol) WHERE t.name = $test_name RETURN s.id AS id, c.hits AS hits ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return symbol ids with no incoming COVERS relationship, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (s:Symbol) OPTIONAL MATCH (:Test)-[c:COVERS]->(s) WITH s, count(c) AS coverage WHERE coverage = 0 RETURN s.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return each covered symbol id and total coverage hits as hits, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (:Test)-[c:COVERS]->(s:Symbol) RETURN s.id AS id, sum(c.hits) AS hits ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return ids and names of symbols whose tags contain 'api', ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (s:Symbol) WHERE 'api' IN s.tags RETURN s.id AS id, s.name AS name ORDER BY id

cases.task: Create test $name with status $status and duration $duration.
cases.reference_query: CREATE (:Test {name: $name, status: $status, duration: $duration})
verify: MATCH (t:Test) WHERE t.name = 'path_modes' RETURN t.name AS name, t.status AS status, t.duration AS duration

cases.task: Set test $name's status to $status without changing its duration.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Test) WHERE t.name = $name SET t.status = $status
verify: MATCH (t:Test {name: 'binder_scope'}) RETURN t.name AS name, t.status AS status, t.duration AS duration

cases.task: Patch file $path with $patch while preserving unspecified properties.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.path = $path SET f = $patch
verify: MATCH (f:File {path: 'README.md'}) RETURN f.path AS path, f.language AS language, f.lines AS lines, f.is_test AS is_test

cases.task: Create one module IMPORTS relationship from $from_path to $to_path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (source:File), (target:File) WHERE source.path = $from_path AND target.path = $to_path CREATE (source)-[:IMPORTS {kind: 'module'}]->(target)
verify: MATCH (source:File)-[i:IMPORTS]->(target:File) WHERE source.path = 'README.md' RETURN target.path AS target, i.kind AS kind

cases.task: Delete only the CALLS relationship from symbol $caller_id to $callee_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (caller:Symbol)-[c:CALLS]->(callee:Symbol) WHERE caller.id = $caller_id AND callee.id = $callee_id DELETE c
verify: MATCH (caller:Symbol)-[:CALLS]->(callee:Symbol) RETURN caller.id AS caller_id, callee.id AS callee_id ORDER BY caller_id, callee_id

cases.task: Set CALLS.count to $count only from $caller_id to $callee_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (caller:Symbol)-[c:CALLS]->(callee:Symbol) WHERE caller.id = $caller_id AND callee.id = $callee_id SET c.count = $count
verify: MATCH (caller:Symbol)-[c:CALLS]->(callee:Symbol) WHERE caller.id = 's1' AND callee.id = 's5' RETURN c.count AS count

cases.task: Delete symbol $symbol_id and its attached relationships without deleting other symbols.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (s:Symbol) WHERE s.id = $symbol_id DETACH DELETE s
verify: MATCH (s:Symbol) RETURN s.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (:Symbol)-[c:CALLS]->(:Symbol) RETURN count(c) AS calls

cases.task: Create one COVERS relationship from test $test_name to symbol $symbol_id with $hits hits.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Test), (s:Symbol) WHERE t.name = $test_name AND s.id = $symbol_id CREATE (t)-[:COVERS {hits: $hits}]->(s)
verify: MATCH (t:Test)-[c:COVERS]->(s:Symbol) WHERE t.name = 'cli_json' RETURN s.id AS symbol_id, c.hits AS hits ORDER BY symbol_id

cases.task: Return todo task ids and titles, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.status = 'todo' RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return id, title, and priority for tasks with priority at least $minimum, ordered by priority descending then id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.priority >= $minimum RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title, t.priority AS priority ORDER BY priority DESC, id

cases.task: For tasks with an owner, return owner and task count as tasks, ordered by owner.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.owner IS NOT NULL RETURN t.owner AS owner, count(*) AS tasks ORDER BY owner

cases.task: Return ids and titles of tasks with no owner, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.owner IS NULL RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.task: For task $id, return direct prerequisite task ids and titles ordered by dependency_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (task:Task)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Task) WHERE task.id = $id RETURN dependency.id AS dependency_id, dependency.title AS title ORDER BY dependency_id

cases.task: For prerequisite task $id, return directly dependent task ids ordered by dependent_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (dependent:Task)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Task) WHERE dependency.id = $id RETURN dependent.id AS dependent_id ORDER BY dependent_id

cases.task: Return todo tasks that have no non-done prerequisite as id and title, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.status = 'todo' AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Task) WHERE dependency.status <> 'done' } RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return distinct todo task ids that directly depend on a prerequisite not marked done, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Task) WHERE t.status = 'todo' AND dependency.status <> 'done' RETURN DISTINCT t.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return distinct prerequisite ids reachable from task $id in one to three DEPENDS_ON hops, ordered by dependency_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (task:Task)-[:DEPENDS_ON*TRAIL 1..3]->(dependency:Task) WHERE task.id = $id RETURN DISTINCT dependency.id AS dependency_id ORDER BY dependency_id

cases.task: Return one shortest path from task $from_id to prerequisite $to_id using one to five DEPENDS_ON hops as path.
cases.reference_query: MATCH path = (source:Task)-[:DEPENDS_ON*SHORTEST 1..5]->(target:Task) WHERE source.id = $from_id AND target.id = $to_id RETURN path AS path LIMIT 1

cases.task: Use topological_levels over Task and DEPENDS_ON. Return node id and level ordered by level then id.
cases.reference_query: CALL topological_levels(['Task'], ['DEPENDS_ON']) YIELD node, level RETURN node.id AS id, level AS level ORDER BY level, id

cases.task: Use weakly_connected_components over Task and DEPENDS_ON. Return node id and component_id ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: CALL weakly_connected_components(['Task'], ['DEPENDS_ON']) YIELD node, component_id RETURN node.id AS id, component_id AS component_id ORDER BY id

cases.task: For owned tasks, return owner and total estimate as estimate, ordered by owner.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.owner IS NOT NULL RETURN t.owner AS owner, sum(t.estimate) AS estimate ORDER BY owner

cases.task: Return task ids whose tags contain 'agent', ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE 'agent' IN t.tags RETURN t.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return each task id and first tag as first_tag, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) RETURN t.id AS id, t.tags[1] AS first_tag ORDER BY id

cases.task: For task $id, return touched artifact name and change kind ordered by artifact.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task)-[touch:TOUCHES]->(artifact:Artifact) WHERE t.id = $id RETURN artifact.name AS artifact, touch.change AS change ORDER BY artifact

cases.task: Return task ids with no TOUCHES relationship, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[touch:TOUCHES]->(:Artifact) WITH t, count(touch) AS touches WHERE touches = 0 RETURN t.id AS id ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return distinct task id and artifact name where artifact risk is at least $risk, ordered by task id then artifact.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task)-[:TOUCHES]->(artifact:Artifact) WHERE artifact.risk >= $risk RETURN DISTINCT t.id AS id, artifact.name AS artifact ORDER BY id, artifact

cases.task: Create task $id with title $title, status $status, priority $priority, owner $owner, estimate $estimate, and tags $tags.
cases.reference_query: CREATE (:Task {id: $id, title: $title, status: $status, priority: $priority, owner: $owner, estimate: $estimate, tags: $tags})
verify: MATCH (t:Task {id: 't7'}) RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title, t.status AS status, t.priority AS priority, t.owner AS owner, t.estimate AS estimate, t.tags AS tags

cases.task: Patch task $id using $patch while preserving every unspecified task property.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.id = $id SET t = $patch
verify: MATCH (t:Task {id: 't4'}) RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title, t.status AS status, t.priority AS priority, t.owner AS owner, t.estimate AS estimate, t.tags AS tags

cases.task: Set task $id's status to $status and preserve every other property.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.id = $id SET t.status = $status
verify: MATCH (t:Task {id: 't3'}) RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title, t.status AS status, t.owner AS owner

cases.task: Create one DEPENDS_ON relationship from task $task_id to prerequisite $dependency_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (task:Task), (dependency:Task) WHERE task.id = $task_id AND dependency.id = $dependency_id CREATE (task)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency)
verify: MATCH (task:Task)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Task) WHERE task.id = 't5' RETURN dependency.id AS dependency_id ORDER BY dependency_id

cases.task: Delete only the DEPENDS_ON relationship from task $task_id to prerequisite $dependency_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (task:Task)-[dependency_edge:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Task) WHERE task.id = $task_id AND dependency.id = $dependency_id DELETE dependency_edge
verify: MATCH (task:Task)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Task) WHERE task.id = 't4' RETURN dependency.id AS dependency_id ORDER BY dependency_id

cases.task: Delete task $id and its attached relationships without deleting any other task.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.id = $id DETACH DELETE t
verify: MATCH (t:Task) RETURN t.id AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (:Task)-[d:DEPENDS_ON]->(:Task) RETURN count(d) AS dependencies

cases.task: Set artifact $name's risk to $risk without changing its other properties.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (artifact:Artifact) WHERE artifact.name = $name SET artifact.risk = $risk
verify: MATCH (artifact:Artifact {name: 'text2koko_bench.py'}) RETURN artifact.name AS name, artifact.kind AS kind, artifact.risk AS risk

cases.task: Return every Note key as id, title, and kind ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (n:Note) RETURN n.key AS id, n.title AS title, n.kind AS kind ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return keys as id and titles of Note nodes whose kind is $kind, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (n:Note) WHERE n.kind = $kind RETURN n.key AS id, n.title AS title ORDER BY id

cases.task: Return each Note key as id and first labels element as first_label, ordered by id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (n:Note) RETURN n.key AS id, n.labels[1] AS first_label ORDER BY id

cases.task: For the Note whose key is $id, return the linked Note key as linked_id and LINKS_TO reason, ordered by linked_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (source:Note)-[link:LINKS_TO]->(target:Note) WHERE source.key = $id RETURN target.key AS linked_id, link.reason AS reason ORDER BY linked_id

cases.task: Return each Note kind and its count as notes, ordered by kind.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (n:Note) RETURN n.kind AS kind, count(*) AS notes ORDER BY kind

cases.task: Patch the Note whose key is $id from $patch while preserving unspecified dynamic properties.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (n:Note) WHERE n.key = $id SET n = $patch
verify: MATCH (n:Note {key: 'n1'}) RETURN n.key AS id, n.title AS title, n.kind AS kind, n.priority AS priority, n.labels AS labels, n.done AS done

cases.task: Create a Note with key $id, title $title, kind $kind, priority $priority, labels $labels, and done $done.
cases.reference_query: CREATE (:Note {key: $id, title: $title, kind: $kind, priority: $priority, labels: $labels, done: $done})
verify: MATCH (n:Note {key: 'n5'}) RETURN n.key AS id, n.title AS title, n.kind AS kind, n.priority AS priority, n.labels AS labels, n.done AS done

cases.task: Set dynamic property score to $score on the Note whose key is $id without changing other properties.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (n:Note) WHERE n.key = $id SET n.score = $score
verify: MATCH (n:Note {key: 'n2'}) RETURN n.key AS id, n.title AS title, n.score AS score, n.done AS done

cases.task: Delete only the LINKS_TO relationship from the Note keyed by $from_id to the Note keyed by $to_id.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (source:Note)-[link:LINKS_TO]->(target:Note) WHERE source.key = $from_id AND target.key = $to_id DELETE link
verify: MATCH (source:Note)-[:LINKS_TO]->(target:Note) RETURN source.key AS from_id, target.key AS to_id ORDER BY from_id, to_id

cases.task: Delete the Note whose key is $id and its attached relationships without deleting other notes.
cases.reference_query: MATCH (n:Note) WHERE n.key = $id DETACH DELETE n
verify: MATCH (n:Note) RETURN n.key AS id ORDER BY id
MATCH (:Note)-[link:LINKS_TO]->(:Note) RETURN count(link) AS links
